2609.17435.title: Right Tool, Right Job: Native-Language Evaluation, Tokenizer Sensitivity, and Methodological Findings from a French-Only BabyLM
2609.17435.paper_summary: We submit MéTRON-FR, a 125M GPT-2 pretrained on 92.47M words of French, to the BabyLM 2026 Strict track. It scores 85.97 +/- 0.17% on QFrBLiMP (a native Quebec-French benchmark of grammatical minimal pairs) and 62.80% on the BabyLM-weighted leaderboard. A cross-lingual GLUE (General Language Understanding Evaluation) protocol that combines French task-data translation with rank-16 LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) produces a sharp task-type gradient: relational tasks gain measurably, while world-knowledge tasks regress. Bilingual Lexicon Induction aligns the French embeddings to GPT-2 at p@1 = 68.84 +/- 8.61%, 18X above chance, suggesting cross-lingual alignment tracks acquired grammatical competence rather than training duration. An ablation study shows that single-token zero-shot scoring is dominated by tokenizer and template artifacts at the child scale, motivating tokenizer-swap sensitivity, placebo-controlled prompting, and native-language minimal-pair benchmarks as standard diagnostics.
2609.17435.paper_summary_zh: 我們提交了 MéTRON-FR，一個在 92.47M 字法語上預訓練的 125M GPT-2，參加 BabyLM 2026 嚴格賽道。它在 QFrBLiMP（魁北克法語的語法最小對照基準）上得分 85.97 +/- 0.17%，在 BabyLM 加權排行榜上得分 62.80%。一個跨語言的 GLUE（通用語言理解評估）協議，結合法語任務數據翻譯和 rank-16 LoRA（低秩適應），產生了明顯的任務類型梯度：關係任務有明顯增益，而世界知識任務則回退。雙語詞典引導將法語嵌入對齊至 GPT-2，p@1 = 68.84 +/- 8.61%，是隨機機會的 18 倍，這表明跨語言對齊追蹤的是獲得的語法能力，而非訓練時間。一項消融研究顯示，在兒童規模下，單標記零-shot 評分受到標記器和模板工件的主導，這促使了標記器交換敏感性、安慰劑控制提示和母語最小對照基準作為標準診斷工具。
2609.17435.author: Adam Zachary Wasserman et.al.
